Name: Planty Interface
Author: Jay2876
Description: This mod changes the interface of the game to be brown with leaf accents. Right now, the mod is very new and is open to suggestions to make it better. I will be working on updating this mod to make sure it is the best it can be.

Downloads.Description: A nice, cozy interface that adds leaves and a softer brown to Stardew Valley.
